title: Sparkly pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE066'>
    <path d='M22 14 l3 7 7 3 -7 3 -3 7 -3 -7 -7 -3 7 -3 z'/>
    <path d='M80 20 l2.5 6 6 2.5 -6 2.5 -2.5 6 -2.5 -6 -6 -2.5 6 -2.5 z'/>
    <path d='M78 76 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M18 70 l2 4.5 4.5 2 -4.5 2 -2 4.5 -2 -4.5 -4.5 -2 4.5 -2 z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#FFB3E6'>
    <circle cx='34' cy='30' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='34' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='60' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='62' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- scissor blades (metallic light) -->
  <g stroke='#C8D4E8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='52' x2='88' y2='20'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='52' x2='88' y2='82'/>
  </g>
  <g stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='54' y1='50' x2='84' y2='24'/>
    <line x1='54' y1='54' x2='84' y2='78'/>
  </g>
  <!-- pivot -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='52' r='5' fill='#9FB6DA'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='52' r='2.2' fill='#E8F0FF'/>
  <!-- handles -->
  <g fill='none' stroke='#FF5C7A' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='44' rx='9' ry='11'/>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='62' rx='9' ry='11'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='none' stroke='#FF9AAF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='44' rx='9' ry='11'/>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='62' rx='9' ry='11'/>
  </g>
  <!-- connect handles to pivot -->
  <g stroke='#FF5C7A' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='37' y1='47' x2='45' y2='51'/>
    <line x1='37' y1='59' x2='45' y2='53'/>
  </g>
</svg>
